scope: Existing passive scalar reflected annular TE/TM slab; fixed radii, source weights, material and k0=4+0.05i. Thickness d and uniform target-height shift change. Not full FDTD or full dyadic Maxwell.
quadrature_revision: v3: split 0..10 in 0.25 intervals, 10..30 in 0.5, 30..50 in 2.0; v1/v2 coarse intervals failed independent reference convergence and were preserved. Same physics and acceptance criteria.
confirmation: Pilot first, then five fresh paired processes on largest case; randomized method order, single-thread CPU complex128. Hot repetitions are not independent samples.
fairness: v4: Every method reuses both Bessel/height factors, material roots, source FFT within each forward+two-derivative call. Modal baseline rebuilds only three matrices for nonnegative m and shares them for both signs; no duplicated +/- preparation, Bessel rebuild, or unused derivatives. Factor_separate is an ablation, modal_cached is the strong matched prepared baseline. v3 correct pilot retained as superseded baseline.
cost: Cold includes common factor preparation; warm sums changed spectral weights, modal preparation if selected, and applications. End-to-end totals are measured phase-sum estimates. Sources may change at every call; no cross-call source cache. Retained array bytes are not peak RSS.
validation: Match existing production operator and finite differences in focused tests; compare all three actions across methods for each state. Independently refine quadrature on representative ring pairs using direct J0 separation and 4-boundary reflection solve; correctness audits are posthoc, not a deployable certificate. No new truncation rank or adaptive policy claim.
